remarks: Quality built by Essex Homes and currently under construction for anticipated Spring 2027 completion, 38 Glen Meadow Drive offers low-maintenance luxury in The Preserve at Glen Meadow - an intimate East Amherst community nearing sellout, with only two homes remaining. This desirable condo-status community offers significantly reduced property taxes, while HOA service includes lawn maintenance, landscaping, fertilization and snow removal for a low monthly fee. This popular 1,674 sq ft Berkley patio-home ranch features 2 bedrooms plus a versatile den/optional 3rd bedroom, 2 full bathrooms, and a thoughtfully designed open layout. A welcoming covered front porch, stone accents, and professional exterior lighting create exceptional curb appeal. Inside, 9' ceilings, rich crown molding, and modern wide-plank flooring set an elegant tone throughout the main living areas. The beautifully appointed kitchen features quartz countertops, a Blanco sink, stainless steel appliances, large pantry, and generous breakfast bar seating, opening seamlessly into the dining area and spacious great room. A box ceiling with crown molding and accent lighting adds architectural detail, while the gas fireplace creates a warm focal point for everyday living and entertaining. Just off the dining area, a covered porch extends the living space outdoors. The private primary suite offers a box ceiling, spacious customizable walk in closet, and spa-inspired bathroom with dual quartz vanities and an oversized frameless glass shower with tile seat and curb-less entry. A secondary bedroom, full guest bathroom, first-floor laundry, mudroom with built-in bench, and a 2-car garage complete the main level.  Professionally landscaped with hydro-seeded lawn and whole yard programmable sprinkler system, this turnkey new home also includes a full basement and new-home warranty. Some photos have been digitally staged and depict a similar home. Be among the final homeowners to call The Preserve at Glen Meadow home! Also listed as single family B1720724
